method.workload: Synthetic timer/stub-controlled I/O; no production or remote RPC measurements
method.source: git archive of exact versioned utils/sdk/rebalancer source, compiled with the repository TypeScript compiler into per-version dist; identical installed external dependencies
method.execution: One process; both versions imported before warmup; sequential alternating AB/BA measurement order; no overlapping benchmark workloads
method.latency: Elapsed per workload; multi-iteration samples report per-workload averages; failure case includes draining outstanding reads and separately records API latency
method.throughput_unit: Complete map call, fee estimate, or monitor cycle per second, not individual RPC calls
method.memory: Shared-process RSS after each sample, not per-version allocation or isolated workload peak
method.cpu: Process CPU user+system deltas; includes harness counters/output validation and any GC during the sample
method.gc: No forced GC; same process and alternating version order
method.provider_count: Controlled provider-stub invocations, not production wire RPC counts; getFeeData is modeled as one read
